geography-quiz: See how well you can pinpoint some major world cities.
silverlight-photo-carousel: A Silverlight 1.0-based photo carousel displaying interesting photos from Flickr. The application was implemented in Script#.
byownerport.com: This is a mashup of craigslist and Google Maps. People can sell, rent, find houses or find roommates. Instead of entering a zip code, you actually fly there, and focus on the area you want to live in from a birds eye view..
geopix-fractal-view: The fractal view of GeoPix shows a fractal tiled structure over an interactive map. The user controls the point of view and the scale using the map, and the system fills the tiles in the fractal view with the appropriate images.
geopix-0: Explore the world and see pictures placed directly on the map. You can filter the pictures using the tags and click on pictures to save your favorites in an itinerary.
climate-change-2030: Architecture 2030 study of climate induced sea level rise on coastal cities in United States. See side by side images of what will happen.
prosper-itus: Application using the Prosper API to help lenders and group leaders get the most out of their Prosper membership.
iphonecnews: Made for the iPhone, provides reviews and prices. Uses iPhone Atom code, Google Ajax Feeds, and CNET. Search lets you enter a product number and get reviews and prices, which is handy when you are in a store like Best Buy.
do-my-sport: Virtual Earth Mashup to help find sports location and event in your area. You can find out about the sports you are interested in and event arrange a meeting of your own at your favourite location. Make new friends who do the same sports as you.
two-degrees: Search the friends lists of your friends to find people who should be on your own list.
newhottness: Feed of the latest stuff from amazon.com with links to Netflix, Blockbuster, or other vendors for rental and purchase.
touropia: Provides an overview of travel highlights around the world using interactive maps with destinations such as cities, beaches, national parks and cultural sites.
cyberandorra-widget: See hotel availabilities and reserve a room in the principality of Andorra, which is on the border of France and Spain.
walk-score: Walk Score shows you a map of what is nearby and calculates a Walk Score for any property. Buying a house in a walkable neighborhood is good for your health and good for the environment.
placespotting: Play a game based on Google Maps. You can create riddles and try to solve riddles created by other people. You get a picture of a place somewhere on Earth and have to find this place.
onair-bus-tracker: Follow the weather, time, and photos from the OnAIR Bus Tour. Watch the animated bus route coordinated with the dials.
onair-air-app: A mash-up of the Adobe OnAIR Bus Tour data from onair.adobe.com with this downloadable AIR application.
find-garage-sales-map: Find garage sales, local estate sales, multi-family yard sales in your area by looking at a map. Plan your trip here by comparing garage sales by location.
geopet: Take a tour on a world map to see all of our pets and their locations.
taxiwiz: Get the fare before you ride. This mashup calculates the approximate fare for taxi rides between two addresses. It uses Google Maps to plot and calculate the driving distance between two points and uses that information to calculate the fare.
ichess: Play a chess game with iGoogle as your opponent.
rosetta: Site combines the Ning.com platform with Ether.com to create a site where interpreters can find work.
orderitontheweb.com: OrderItOnTheWeb.com is an online shopping mashup. It mixes and mashes Amazon Web Services, Google Maps, Yahoo Local, and YouTube for video product reviews.
jagbox: Upload a file to Amazon S3 and share the link to that file with others. Recipients of the link can access and download the User File by clicking on the link.
superpages: Web-based version of the SuperPages. Uses Virtual Earth mapping technology to find businesses and services in your area. Driving directions, hours, and more are provided. Good wifi finder.
abramex: This service uses Yahoo and other tools to come up with suggestions using meta-data to make documents easier to find.
used-cars-sale: More then 4 million used cars for sale. Data comes from the Vast API.
bestperf: A Web 2.0 site for people to track their sports records, beat chronos, challenge friends and discover new routes.
skyshot-maps: Interactive map of The English Riviera, in Torquay Devon. Showing hotels, attractions, historical points of interest, restaurants, pubs and clubs. The site also has video tours and a photo gallery.
map-runner: Map Runner is a collection of runners routes, created by users.
salaryscout: SalaryScout is a network of users seeking fairness in compensation and benefits. Discover your true value in the marketplace and demand what you are worth.
infobiliaria.es-real-estate-spain: A Google Earth and Google Maps mash up for real state agents in Spain.
youtube-slideshow-google-maps: This slideshow uses Google Maps tile layers. Map images are replaced with YouTube thumbnail images, so you can scroll images by clicking and dragging. When you want to play the video, just click the image and push the play button.
google-yahoo-traffic-weather-maps: Yahoo traffic data mapped on Google Maps. Includes weather from worldweather.org.
spinlets: Spinlets are small widgets for Web 2.0 sites you can post onto your blog, website or network profile.
immoplaza: ImmoPlaza is a new French real estate website, providing a nice geolocalized interface based on Google Maps API. ImmoPlaza is the French equivalent of Trulia or Zillow.
turtilla-rss-mashup-tool: Turtilla is an online service which allows you to search and filter content related to your interests. This content is captured from a large variety of sources. The generated results can be converted to an RSS feed.
business-baseball-google-maps: Google Maps Mashup of Forbes data on the Most valuable teams in MLB. Also includes Yahoo Sports MLB RSS feeds.
weddingwire: WeddingWire uses GoogleMaps to mashup thousands of wedding vendors locations such as florists, photographers, DJs, etc. in the US.
catalist-homes-california: Real estate search for Southern California. Search for properties meeting specific criteria. Hover over a specific property on the map to reveal address and price.
one-trick-towns-america: Map of Inc. magazine list of American One Trick Towns. Includes Punxsutawney for Ground Hog Day, the North Pole, Gilroy Garlic Festival, the Most Haunted Town, Paris Texas, and others.
alertnet: Display crisis hotspots on a world map and retrieve latest news on each crisis from Reuters.
world-nirvana: Dynamic tribute to Kurt Cobain, showing Nirvana live concerts on a Google map by year. Search for videos directly by keywords.
picnik-online-photo-editing: Quickly edit all your online photos from your browser. Web-based way to fix underexposed photos, remove red-eye, or apply effects to your photos. All online.
leawood-crime-mapping: Crime mapping site for Leawood, Kansas.
jukeboxtube: A jukebox-like playlist for YouTube videos. No need to listen to your own MP3s when YouTube already has everything online.
gps-tracks: Upload your GPS tracks stored in GPX format, and see your tracks and your friends tracks in satellite view.
cyberandorra: Find Andorra hotels directly on a map, with photos and information.
dormitem-free-college-classifieds: A free college classified site that aggregates listings from niche college marketplaces across the country. Uses Google maps to feature microregional searching, integrated with Facebook, and has Rapleaf buyer-seller feedback system.
plotshot-random-plot-generator: A random plot generator with a twist, this site uses the Flickr API to retrieve shots that match the plots. Sometimes the result is a series of amazing matches, other times it is funny how wrong they are.
hipoqih.com: hipoqih.com is a system composed of a Web and plugin for mobile devices that allow recording warnings and URL associated to any geopoint in the planet. These warnings can be show automatically in terminals with the plugin when approaching that geopoint.
alpinaut: The adventure sports route diagrams search engine for rock and ice climbing, caving, canyoning, hiking, skiing, snowshoeing, mountain biking, via ferrata.
kqed-quest: Quest utilizes all of the KQED Public Broadcasting media platforms. Interactive site uses Google Map and Flickr mashups to present high-quality television programs, radio spots, blog postings, education guides, and map-based explorations.
productdose: Online shopping site for men built using the shopping.com API.
domains-topic-delexa.org: Interesting mashup uses the top 50,000 sites as determined by Alexa and del.icio.us tags to organize domains by topic. It can be used to find high quality links in the topic area of your choice that is both topically related and likely to be high-powered.
map2tag-french-touch-map: Create maps, share places, tag, bookmark favorite places, add Flickr images and YouTube videos.
sowetouprisings-.com: Documents the June 16th, 1976 uprisings in Soweto, South Africa.
sofatube: SofaTube is a specially designed web application that lets you browse and watch videos from YouTube and Revver in your living room where viewers are usually sitting far away from their standard or high definition television.
stumblevideo: The terrific StumbleUpon service adds the ability for users to select, rate and discover videos from YouTube, Google Video and MySpace.
veilingkijker: Dutch mashup that searches multiple auction sites and links to Google Maps to locate the item on sale.
bank-anywhere.com: Combines FDIC Bank branch data with Google Maps. Includes flexible search by zip, city and address.
faunapolis: A place where you can share interesting photos and stories about animals that live in this new jungle we call town, city, backyard, or even our bodies. Faunapolis purpose is to document these wild creatures with geolocaion, visual, and time information.
plymouth-half-marathon: This was my first mashup since leaving Ordnance Survey. But I wanted to add an extra bit, so there are several layers which can be turned on and off plus embeded Flash video in the marker pop-up
fishny: FishNY is a website dedicated to sportfishing in New York State. Our goal is to map all of the best fishing locations in the State.
slippymap: Example of how to search by address to find points of interest in your area based on Where2GetIt that requires no javascript.
political-turkeys-year: A look at Political Turkeys as reported by CNN.
bicycle-portal: Create and find bicycle routes for your area. Total distance and elevation graph are calculated as you create the route. Live traffic cams, photos from the ground, known routes, topo maps. Weather feeds for selected cities.
boddit: Offers price comparison for online deals. It aggregates deals from a variety of bargain hunting websites into a slick price comparison engine.
outdoorphotoop: A community-based website for finding and sharing outdoor photography locations such as landscapes, panoramas, wildlife, wildflowers, waterfalls, cityscapes, canyons, and others.
zoomatron-nautical-maps: Very cool overlay of NOAA nautical charts on top of Virtual Earth maps engine. Charts can be made translucent.
top-10-paid-women: Map of the Top 10 paid women as reported by Fortune Magazine.
global-weather-service: Dagbladet.no uses Google Maps, global geocoding, ajax and global geocoded weather forecast for this experimental weather service.
gis-jobs-map: GIS Jobs Clearinghouse and Google Maps comes together in GIS Jobs Listing Map. This map was developed by terra IMS in collaboration with the GIS Jobs Clearinghouse. Terra IMS geocodes job listings and displays them on a Google Map.
boomtrek: Local search resource for travellers. Enter your location and type of business or address. Covers wide variety of locations.
most-trusted-celebrities: Forbes list of the most Trusted Celebrieties in American. Mapped with links to Google Videos.
divecenters.net: Database with dive centers, dive boats, dive shops around the world.
educationsearch.net: An education search tool which enables you to search by: Location, Career, Industry/Salary and provides personalized searches to save for future reference. Utilizes Flickr, Google Maps and YouTube.
great-wedding-network: Use maps to locate professionals and vendors to help organize and provide services for a wedding. You can also create a personal Wedding Atlas to share important information about a bridal party.
virtual-van: B2B integration looking to deliver the benefits of a high-transaction-charge value-added-network, a VAN, without high on-going transaction fees. Built on Amazon Simple Queue and Storage services.
neave.tv: A mash-up of the most creative videos found on Google Video, YouTube, Blip.tv and other video sharing sites.
caddymap: Google Maps mashup with searchable US Golf Courses, weather data and details golf course information.
postal-code-mapper: Maps postal codes to geographical coordinates and shows them on a map.
gootube: YouTube meets Google Maps. A real estate listings service that streams videos of properties on sale inside Google map
nfl-fan-mapping-site: Create and share maps to places near your favorite NFL stadium, including tailgates, restaurants, clubs, and seats.
raced-and-rallied-uk-motorsports: Interactive listing of UK Motorsport venues - motor racing circuits, kart circuits, ovals, speedway venues, hillclimbs, sprints, airfields and more.
canalplan-ac: A canal journey planner, with virtual canal trips using Google maps and user contributed photos.
gmapwiki.com: GmapWiki is A MapWiki System On Google Maps and a library of interesting satellite-photographed places for google earth.
missing-kids-map: A mashup using data from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.
similarity-web: Search for any product on amazon and visualize its 2-level deep similarity web in Flash. Nice visualization
skatespots.net: An simple, open skatespot database with searchable entries and locations plotted on Google maps.
bikely: Discover and share your favorite bicycle routes. Bikely helps cyclists share knowledge of good Australian bicycle routes.
mapcruncher: Very interesting mashup technique from Microsoft Research, MSR. Shows how any type of map image data can be layered on top of a Virtual Earth map. This example with bike trail maps.
eventsites: Eventsites allows users to create a mini-website for their event complete with description, a Google Map and photos from Flickr. Eventsites is unusual as a mashup in that the entire site is built using only AJAX and it stores no data of its own.
jigdo: JigDo combines Google Maps with the most popular trading website in the Netherlands: Marktplaats.nl.
live-mapping-2006-nfl-draft: Join MapGameDay.com on April 29th as we live map the NFL Draft. View drafted players by NFL Team, Hometown, and College.
virtual-tourism: Google Maps and Google Video mashup. Select tourist sites from around the world on Google maps and see a video of the location.
color-fields-colr-pickr: Great way to find Flickr photos by color. Select colors diretly or use the slider to adjust lightness and darkness. By Jim Bumgardner.
mysic.com: A shopping service that gives a unique view into the Amazon catalog: Line charts show you price and sales rank over time.
pacific-northwest-venture-map: Map of Pacific Northwest venture capital funding including Seattle, Portland, etc.
early-gothic-architecture-france: Multple ways of looking at maps, Images, Google Earth KML files for about 1,500 early gothic sites in Northern France, using Google Earth, Google, Wikipedia, Flickr, Clusty, Mapquest. The original data comes from the work of Dr. John James.
jabber-google-map: Shows the positions and status of Jabber - GTalk users and allows personal places to be marked and commented.
waterloo-student-housing-map: Waterloo Student Housing to help college and university students find rental housing and sublets. Combines UW housing database with Google Maps.
popurls.com: Popular urls to the latest web buzz. Combines over 15 concensus filters into a one-page view. Good looking, Ajax-ish interface. Includes Digg, Flickr, BoingBoing, NewsVine, del.icio.us, Reddit and others.
castingwords.com: Podcast transcript search and transcription service built using the Amazon Mechanical Turk API.
joemap: A do-it-yourself Goolge Maps site. You can create maps, upload photos, add comments and ratings. Explore maps created by other users.
googlecloud: Displays Google search terms in a tag cloud. Uses Yahoo Term Extraction API to group terms together. Greasemonkey script available.
fortune-100-best-companies-map: A Google Map showing the headquarters of the 100 best US companies to work for as ranked by Fortune Magazine. Marker popups give details on each.
seetoronto-virtual-tour: Take full 360 degree photo tours of popular Toronto landmarks like the Air Canada Centre, Rogers Centre, and CBC HQ. Good quality, large images.
flickrscape: Enter a word and watch the flickr photo stream. Click to interrupt stream and try another word.
fxfoto: Windows desktop application for managing photo scrapbooks. With photo service upload capabilities.
spell-flickr: Type a word or phrase into this fun Flickr application and it will return a set of images spelling-out that word, ransom-note style.
ziprealty: Full MLS real estate listings using Google Maps. As of October 2006 also offers data provided by the Zillow API.
rentslicer: Rental property statistics for major metropolitan areas.
platial: Platial enables people to find, create and use meaningful maps of Places that matter to them.
delancey: This nice del.icio.us enhancement allows you to see which of your del.icio.us bookmarks are used most frequently. By DeWitt Clinton.
goocam: This is a Google map of unprotected/open camera streams obtained from Google searches. The IP addresses for each camera's url has been mapped to its Geo-location. Sometimes loads slowly. Some cams NSFW.
retrievr-search-sketch: retrievr is an experimental service which lets you search and explore in a selection of Flickr images by drawing a rough sketch. Very interesting.
liveplasma: A visually rich application that combines the Amazon API to show the relationship between movies, bands, actors, etc. You can go straight from interacting to making purchases.
geoworldnews: The latest worldwide stories from the Washington Post plotted on a Google Maps satellite image.
maphistory.org: Google Map of historic locations in US cities. Initially in Philadelphia and Washington D.C.
esri-shapefile-viewer: Plots shapefiles on Virtual Earth maps.
bbc-news-map: See where the latest news is happening in the UK.
los-taco-trucks-unitos: A Google Map for when you need to find a taco truck in Seattle.
seattle-real-estate-advisor: Seattle real estate profiles plotted on Google Maps.
toeat.com: Utilizing Google Maps + AJAX + Lots of Restaurants
daily-mashup: Combines popular items from Flickr, Del.icio.us, furl, and Yahoo News.
del.icio.us-direc.tor: Ajax-style prototype for an alternative web-based rich UI for del.icio.us
